Pretendo ultrapassar

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Pretendo ultrapassar?

In this glossary, Pretendo ultrapassar refers to: Announcement that a vessel plans to pass another vessel ahead on a specified side in accordance with the COLREGS.

How is Pretendo ultrapassar used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "MV Vega, aqui navio cargueiro Aurora: pretendo ultrapassar pelo boreste na bóia Charlie, confirme e informe intenções."

Why does Pretendo ultrapassar matter in maritime?

Pretendo ultrapassar matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Pretendo ultrapassar?

Pretendo ultrapassar is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

Definition

Announcement that a vessel plans to pass another vessel ahead on a specified side in accordance with the COLREGS.

Operational example

MV Vega, this is cargo vessel Aurora: intend overtake on your starboard side at buoy Charlie, please acknowledge and advise intentions.

Localized term

Pretendo ultrapassar

Localized example

MV Vega, aqui navio cargueiro Aurora: pretendo ultrapassar pelo boreste na bóia Charlie, confirme e informe intenções.
